jobs.title: Too good for it, ii
jobs.prompt: a four-panel newspaper comic strip, four equal panels in a single horizontal row with thin black gutters (4 panels). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Cast, drawn the same in every panel, ages exactly as given: WOOD — aged 20, thin young man with a slouch, three days' stubble, hair longer, brown canvas chore coat with a frayed cuff and one mismatched button, hands always in its pockets; BARNABY (the dog) — a low-slung terrier and hound mix, long body, short legs, folded velvet ears, wiry white-and-tan coat, gray on the muzzle from 2004, cloudy eyes from 2009, carried from 2010. Title of the strip: DRIFT WOOD. The strip: Chloe calls. Long distance. Two minutes. The strip gives her the panel she asks for. Panel 1: a young man sitting on a hallway floor with a landline phone, the cord stretched taut from the wall, a dog in a bedroom doorway, black and white (in this panel: WOOD, BARNABY (the dog)). Panel 2: close-up of a telephone receiver held to a young man's ear, a jagged speech balloon coming from the earpiece. Panel 3: a young man on the floor winding a phone cord tightly around one finger (in this panel: WOOD). Panel 4: a young man sitting on a hallway floor with the phone receiver set down beside him emitting a flat dial-tone line, a small dog sitting on his foot, no words (in this panel: WOOD, BARNABY (the dog)). No text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature; leave clean space in each panel where balloons would go. Reference @wood_20 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @barnaby is the model sheet for BARNABY (the dog): match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Match the attached references: @wood_20 for the character Wood at 20-23; @barnaby for the character Barnaby; @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17.
